Scenario fixture: embedded-refresh-review (RGAA 13.1.1)

Each target has an id of the form err_case_NN. RGAA 13.1.1 lists object, embed, svg, canvas and meta as refresh methods; the rule asks about the first four, since the markup does not show whether they refresh.

A. Possible refresh methods (CANTTELL)

01 — CANTTELL: an <object> that embeds a live scores page
02 — CANTTELL: an <embed> that embeds a news ticker
03 — CANTTELL: a <canvas>, which a script draws and may redraw
04 — CANTTELL: an <svg> that holds a script

B. Not asked about (NOT APPLICABLE)

05 — NOT APPLICABLE: an <object> that shows a PNG image
06 — NOT APPLICABLE: an inline <svg> icon with no script
